name: XLA_TRANSACTION_ENTITIES
description: This table contains a row for each transaction for which events have been raised in Subledger Accounting.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifies subledger transactions associated with the accounting events.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a recognized party with given rights and responsibilities by legislation.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Character).

columns.name: SECURITY_ID_INT_1
columns.description: Flexible security identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SECURITY_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Flexible security identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SECURITY_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Flexible security identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SECURITY_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: Flexible security identifier (Character).

columns.name: SECURITY_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Flexible security identifier (Character).

columns.name: SECURITY_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Flexible security identifier (Character).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Character).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Character).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_INT_4
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Integer).

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_CHAR_4
columns.description: Flexible source identifier (Character).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of a business relationship involving one or more parties and products, such as a change in the ownership, location or status of a product.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: VALUATION_METHOD
columns.description: Valuation of an underlying accounting event that can be valued with a different monetary value and accounted differently.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the source application.

columns.name: UPG_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the upgrade batch.

columns.name: UPG_SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the upgrading application.

columns.name: UPG_VALID_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if validation was successfully run for the batch.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which this journal will be stored.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of the transaction date. It is used only for archive and purge process. It may not be the same as the accounting entry period name for this event.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Original transaction number from the Accounting Hub transaction data file.
